title: Power Consumption & Thermal Analysis
description: Measure or collect power consumption and thermal data for all comparison set GPUs under inference load. For each GPU, report: (1) Idle power (W), (2) Inference load power at 50% and 100% utilization (W), (3) Peak power (including transient spikes), (4) Thermal throttling threshold and behavior (at what temperature does clock speed drop?), (5) Cooling solution quality: single-fan vs dual-fan vs triple-fan, reference vs AIB partner designs, (6) Noise level at full load (dB) where available, (7) Electricity cost analysis: monthly electricity cost at typical usage patterns (4 hrs/day inference), (8) Power supply requirements: minimum PSU wattage, connector type (1x8-pin, 12VHPWR, 2x8-pin), (9) Thermal design for sustained workloads: can the GPU maintain boost clock for hours of continuous inference? (important for long context generation), (10) eGPU thermal considerations: external enclosure thermal impact on performance. Sources: TechPowerUp, Gamers Nexus, Hardware Unboxed, Tom's Hardware, and independent measurements. For Mac Studio, report Apple's published TDP and measured power consumption.
